title: ononis spinosa subsp. procurrens
intro: Ononis spinosa subsp. procurrens, commonly known as the "spiny restharrow", is a subspecies of the Ononis spinosa plant, which is a type of flowering plant in the legume family (Fabaceae). The spiny restharrow has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, digestive issues, and skin problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce pain, prevent infections, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of the spiny restharrow include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
